comment: Independent C-first lawful Samurai with the Enhanced1 (H_UTF8) symbol set. Under SYMHANDLING(H_UTF8), wintty.c process_text_window() sends each line's first byte through g_putch(), whose recorder hook (patch 006) stores it one column right of the terminal cell, where the line's second byte overwrites it. ^X shows the NHW_MENU attributes text window, and the invalid direction key after 'c' shows getdir()'s NHW_TEXT cmdassist help; both leave column 0 of every text row blank.
